rules: Root = node with no parent. Every `scenarios` entry is a root.
Edge: nesting under `children:`. One parent per child.
`defaults[K]` on a node applies to that node and every descendant. A bare key applies to that node only and never cascades.
K in the precedence is a key path, not a top-level key.
Mappings deep-merge across the precedence layers.
An empty value is null or the empty string.
An empty value overrides every lower precedence layer.
A key whose resolved value is empty is absent.
The run is the virtual root: run-only keys bare, all cascading config under the top-level `defaults:`.
A `defaults:` block is a sparse overlay: any subset of config keys, none required. It is not a complete scenario.
`playbooks:` is a top-level convenience alias for `provisioner.playbooks`, valid wherever config is (bare, or under `defaults:`).
`platforms` is permissive: absent/empty is valid. Consumed only by a creating node, ignored otherwise.
The top-level `platforms:` is the catalog, and each entry defines one platform once by `name` with opaque `vars` and selection `labels`.
A scenario's `platforms:` is a selection of catalog names, or inline platform objects for backward compatibility.
A root scenario with no `platforms:` selects the whole catalog. A child selects none of its own and inherits the parent's shared inventory.
Creation stays on the node, whose `playbooks.create` stands up the selected platforms and consumes their `vars`. The catalog dedups definition, not creation.
An inline platform object keeps its `name` exactly as written, as in molecule today.
A catalog selection's instance name is derived from the catalog name plus the scenario and run identity (`design/data/open-questions.yml`).
A catalog name and an inline platform name that match in one run is an error.
`labels:` on a platform or a scenario are selection membership, and a label filters only the dimension it appears on.
`runtime:` is run-only and names the sealed execution the sequence runs inside, with `method: ee | host | <custom>` (`design/data/execution-environments.yml`).
Under the `ee` method, `execution_environments` fans the run out to one cell per EE, and each EE image is a run precondition molecule checks but never builds.
A bare run executes every scenario, platform, and EE, because labels only narrow when named.
A `--label` selection narrows only the dimension its label appears on, and multiple labels union.
A `--skip-label` subtracts the items carrying that label from the run.
A label named for selection that matches nothing in the config fails, the way an unknown field fails.
Sharing is within a tree only. There is no cross-tree share.
Reserved/intrinsic names are clear of molecule's top-level keys. Near-misses (not collisions): `scenario` vs `scenarios`, and molecule's `shared_state` (not a key in this file) vs `shared`.
open: Run args, the caller input to config text, are designed in `design/data/environment.yml` but not yet spelled, so no key declares them yet (`design/data/open-questions.yml`).
Label selection flag spelling must layer against ansible-playbook's own task `--tags` (`design/data/naming.yml`).

runtime.description: The sealed, selectable execution the sequence runs inside. Molecule orders and references it, never builds or inspects its contents (`design/data/execution-environments.yml`).

method.description: How the runtime is provided: `ee` (a container carries the controller toolchain), `host` (the ambient session, no isolation or fan-out), or a registered custom name. python and ansible-core are provenance of a host run, never a declared axis.

executor.description: The pluggable executor. Molecule defines what to run, the executor decides how (local, remote podman, kubernetes, AAP). ansible-runner is one implementation, never a binding.

build_method.description: The pluggable build plugin for the ahead-of-time build phase. `none` builds nothing and images must already exist. ansible-builder is one plugin, never a binding.

execution_environments.description: The `ee` method's axis. A list of EE references, one run cell per entry (and per tag or digest in the discrete form). Molecule checks availability, never builds.

additional_parameters.description: External config for a custom runtime, opaque to molecule. Molecule never descends into it, the custom runtime or executor reads it.

platforms.description: The platform catalog. Each entry defines one platform once by name, with opaque creation vars and selection labels. A scenario selects catalog entries by name (`spec/molecule-config.schema.yml`).

defaults.description: Config for the run and everything below it. A sparse overlay of molecule scenario keys.

scenarios.description: Root nodes. Run in wave order, and top-to-bottom in list order within a wave (serial order, scheduler submit order).

labels.description: Selection labels. A label filters only the dimension it appears on, so a bare run executes everything and a named label narrows only that dimension. A label that matches nothing in the config is rejected.

executionEnvironment.description: One execution-environment reference under `runtime.execution_environments`. A compact string is a full ref parsed into its parts. The discrete object writes repository, image, name and labels once and fans out over tags and digests. Molecule references it, never builds it.

oneOf.description: Compact single cell: a full ref `repository/image:tag` or `repository/image@digest`.

image.description: Image name. repository plus image plus each tag or digest forms one cell's ref.

tags.description: One cell per tag, each resolved to its digest at run time.

name.description: Cell label. Inferred `{image}_{tag}` or `{image}_{last-6-of-digest}` if unset, else replaces the `{image}` prefix.

pull_policy.description: Run-time availability. A Kubernetes concept in ansible-idiom values: `always`, `missing` (default), `never`.

build_opts.description: Per-EE options for the `build_method` plugin, opaque to molecule.

method_opts.description: Per-EE options for the runtime method or executor (mounts, env, resources), opaque to molecule.

catalogPlatform.description: A catalog platform definition. Names a platform once so scenarios select it by name, with opaque creation vars and selection labels. Creation stays on the node in this surface, so no create playbook lives here.

name.description: Catalog identity, referenced by a scenario's `platforms` list. Unique across the catalog.

vars.description: Opaque creation vars passed through to the create step. Molecule holds no knowledge of them.

platformSelection.description: A scenario's platform set: catalog names as strings, or inline platform objects (backward compatible). Absent on a root selects the whole catalog.

config.description: A sparse molecule scenario-config overlay: any subset of these keys, none required. Each value is validated by molecule's own per-key subschema (molecule.json).

playbooks.description: The `provisioner.playbooks` mapping, by path (top-level alias). `create`/`destroy` bare by convention so a parent that creates does not hand creation to children.

driver.description: Typically bare on a creating node, so it is not handed to children.

platforms.description: Selection of catalog platform names, or inline platform objects. Consumed only by a node that creates its own instances (`spec/molecule-config.schema.yml`).

node.description: A scenario as a member of a tree. Node-intrinsic keys, a defaults block, children, and any config key bare (this node only).

name.description: Node identity, selected by `-s`. Unique across the run.

shared.description: On a node with children: `false` stops sharing its inventory down to its children. Never gates creation. No per-child form.

missing_parent.description: Behavior when a depended-on ancestor is not standing. Overridden by `--missing-parent`.

wave.description: Ordering tier among nodes that share a parent (`design/data/scheduling.yml`).

labels.description: Selection labels for this scenario. Filter only the scenario dimension (`spec/molecule-config.schema.yml`).

defaults.description: Config for this node and its subtree. A sparse overlay of molecule scenario keys.

children.description: Child nodes. The nesting is the parent edge (single-file mode).

platforms.description: Selection of catalog platform names, or inline platform objects (`spec/molecule-config.schema.yml`).
